messages:
Rina Shah: Heads-up: SpendMap sent our renewal. New "fast-path" charge + higher per-embedding rate.
Ethan Cole: can you paste the numbers?
Rina Shah: pasted:
```
SpendMap Renewal 2026
- Enterprise base: $21,000/mo
- Fast-path add-on: $3,600/mo
- Embedding unit: $0.0026 per embed (was $0.0020)
- No renewal discount quoted (term 12m)
```
Nina Gomez: I remember a 10% renewal credit last year. Billing, confirm committed ARR and last net invoice.
billing-bot: Contract SM-RED-2025: committed ARR $228,000; renewal credit 10% applied. Net invoiced 2025 = $205,200.
Ethan Cole: OK. Action: Procurement to request reinstated discount or 2yr price lock; Finance to pull month-by-month embedding counts for last 6 months; Ops to ask for justification and metric for "fast-path".
Rina Shah: I'll draft the vendor email. Want: line-item definition of fast-path, monthly embed counts, renewal discount options, and a 30-day pricing hold.
Nina Gomez: Also ask for a trial of fast-path or a reduced onboarding fee if they insist.
Ethan Cole: Draft below, will send after review:
```
Subject: SpendMap  renewal questions and pricing hold request

Hi SpendMap team,
We received the renewal for SM-RED-2026 and need clarification before we proceed:
1) Please provide a line-item explanation of the new "fast-path" charge and the billing metric used.
2) Please provide monthly embedding API usage for the last 6 months (counts per month).
3) Confirm available renewal discounts for 12- or 24-month commitments and any migration/feature credits.
4) Please place the quoted pricing on a 30-day hold while we reconcile usage and contract terms.

We will not approve an auto-renewal with the addon enabled without explicit written acceptance.

Thanks,
Ethan Cole
On behalf of Redwood Inference
```
Rina Shah: billing-bot attach contract and last invoice to the thread please.
billing-bot: Attached: contract_SM-RED-2025.pdf, invoice_2025-12.pdf :white_check_mark:
Nina Gomez: Quick calc: Listed annual w/addon = (21,000+3,600)*12 = $297,600 vs our net last year $205,200 -> ~45% increase. Not acceptable.
Rina Shah: We should aim to either reinstate 10% + remove addon, or keep addon with at least 25% discount on the addon line.
Ethan Cole: Sending now, cc procurement@redwood. Will share their reply here.
Rina Shah: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
